521798711.accepts_evidence: Organizations new to the foundation must submit a Letter of Intent through its online grant system before a full application; returning grantees go straight to the full application. Unsolicited event sponsorship requests are not accepted (https://www.thekahlertfoundation.org/md-how-to-apply/ and https://thekahlertfoundation.org/guidelines)
521798711.conflicts_with_return: Yes. The return says it gives only to preselected organizations, but the site runs an open Letter of Intent route for new applicants in Maryland and Utah.
521798711.contact: Maryland: Ellen Finnerty Myers, Vice President & Executive Director; Wally Hernandez, Grants Manager; Hunter Childs, Grants Coordinator; P.O. Box 1701, Sykesville, MD 21784. Utah: Heather Kahlert, Executive Vice President; Lizzy Karp, Grants Manager (lkarp@thekahlertfoundation.org); Angelica Guzman Rendon, Grants Administrator. Otherwise a contact form; no phone published.
521798711.deadlines: Maryland: request deadlines January 15, May 1 and September 1 for board meetings in February, June and October; a new applicant's LOI is due at least 90 days before the full request deadline. Utah: LOI due February 1 and full application due April 1 for the single June board meeting; later applications wait for the next fiscal year. No year is printed on either page.

521798711.name: The Kahlert Foundation Inc
521798711.not_funded: Unsolicited event sponsorship requests (Maryland). No other exclusions listed.
521798711.notes: Review of a new applicant can take 90 days or more, and the foundation meets new applicants after approving the LOI. Maryland fiscal year runs July 1 to June 30. Utah reviews and pays once a year (payments by July 30). The site's contact-and-team page returned an error; the contact-us page opened.
521798711.page_dated: Footer copyright 2026; 2025 annual report posted October 2025
521798711.types_of_support: Maryland: capital campaigns, special projects or programs, general operations; first-time grantees are encouraged to ask for a specific capital item or project. Multi-year funding is possible in both states but not guaranteed and follows an established relationship.
